EVENT: GCC Healthcare Innovation Summit 2026
TYPE: Healthcare Conference
DATE: 2026-03-12

SESSIONS:
- 09:15 (10min) Opening Remarks
  Speakers: Dr. Hana Al-Mansoori (Conference Chair)
  Moderators: —
  Conference Chair welcomes 350 senior delegates, frames the day's regulatory and digital health agenda, and acknowledges Platinum and Strategic Partners.
- 09:25 (40min) Keynote: Digital Transformation in Regional Healthcare
  Speakers: Dr. Khalid Al-Rashid (Senior Representative, Regional Health Authority)
  Moderators: —
  Headline policy keynote on national digital health strategy, interoperability mandates, and the next phase of regional healthcare modernization.
- 10:05 (45min) Panel: Regulatory Reliance and Cross-Border Collaboration
  Speakers: Dr. Layla Haddad (Health Authority Representative), Omar Farouk (Regulatory Affairs Lead, Pharma Consortium), Prof. Reema Nasser (Clinical Research Expert, Gulf Medical University)
  Moderators: Noura El-Sayed (Industry Affairs Director)
  Three-person panel exploring GCC regulatory reliance pathways, joint reviews, and cross-border data and clinical trial collaboration. Includes 10 minutes audience Q&A.
- 11:20 (10min) Sponsor Spotlight: Platinum Sponsor
  Speakers: —
  Moderators: —
  Branded 10-minute spotlight from the Platinum Sponsor on AI-enabled diagnostics deployments across the region.
- 11:30 (40min) Fireside Chat: AI in Clinical Research
  Speakers: Dr. Yusuf Karim (Clinical Innovation Lead, Regional AI Health Initiative)
  Moderators: James Whitford (Program Director, Summit)
  Two-chair fireside on operationalizing AI in regional clinical research — protocol design, regulatory acceptance, and patient safety guardrails.
- 13:10 (70min) Workshop: Building Patient-Centric Digital Health Pathways
  Speakers: Sara Belhaj (Senior Digital Health Consultant)
  Moderators: —
  Facilitated working session with break-out tables. Delegates map a patient journey across primary care, specialist referral, and remote monitoring touchpoints.
- 14:20 (10min) Closing Remarks
  Speakers: Dr. Hana Al-Mansoori (Conference Chair)
